import { Howl, Howler } from 'howler';

/**
 * Page-wide audio activation. Every Howler import goes through this module so
 * the configuration below is applied before any Howl exists.
 *
 * On iOS, an audible media element that starts playing moves the page into the
 * MediaPlayback audio-session category, which pauses other apps (Spotify). So
 * the page activates audio only from an explicit audio gesture — `armAudio()`
 * — never from Howler's page-wide first-touch listeners or from stream events.
 */

// Howler's auto-unlock attaches capture listeners to the whole document the
// moment any Howl is constructed, turning an unrelated tap into audio activation.
Howler.autoUnlock = false;

// Sequential TTS chunks recycle one or two elements; ten covers overlap from
// iOS Safari's slow release of unloaded elements.
Howler.html5PoolSize = 10;

/** Howler internals used to seed its HTML5 pool with gesture-unlocked elements. */
interface HowlerHtml5Pool {
  _html5AudioPool?: HTMLAudioElement[];
  _releaseHtml5Audio?: (audio: HTMLAudioElement & { _unlocked?: boolean }) => void;
}

let armed = false;
let pcmContext: AudioContext | null = null;

/**
 * Activate audio for this page. Call synchronously inside the user gesture that
 * asks for audio (send-with-audio, narrate, voice-mode enable, push-to-talk)
 * and before any `await`, or iOS rejects the unlock.
 *
 * - Seeds Howler's HTML5 pool with elements loaded inside the gesture, so
 *   `html5: true` Howls created later (TTS chunks, narration autoplay) may play.
 * - Creates or resumes the Web Audio context used for scheduled PCM streams.
 *
 * Repeat calls re-run the unlock, so a failed or interrupted activation recovers
 * on the next gesture.
 */
export function armAudio(): void {
  armed = true;

  const pool = Howler as unknown as HowlerHtml5Pool;
  if (typeof pool._releaseHtml5Audio === 'function' && Array.isArray(pool._html5AudioPool)) {
    while (pool._html5AudioPool.length < Howler.html5PoolSize) {
      const audio = new Audio() as HTMLAudioElement & { _unlocked?: boolean };
      audio.load();
      audio._unlocked = true;
      pool._releaseHtml5Audio(audio);
    }
  }

  try {
    pcmContext ??= new AudioContext();
    if (pcmContext.state !== 'running') {
      pcmContext.resume().catch(() => {
        // Retried on the next armAudio() gesture.
      });
    }
  } catch {
    pcmContext = null;
  }
}

/** Whether this page has been armed by an audio gesture. */
export function isAudioArmed(): boolean {
  return armed;
}

/** The Web Audio context for scheduled PCM playback; null until armed. */
export function getPcmContext(): AudioContext | null {
  return pcmContext;
}

/** Test-only: return to the unarmed state. */
export function resetAudioRuntimeForTests(): void {
  armed = false;
  pcmContext = null;
}

export { Howl, Howler };
